hook_line: DIWALI CRACKERS COST MORE THIS YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Production drop at one Sivakasi factory this year

news_summary: Firecracker prices will rise 15% to 20% this Diwali as production falls sharply in Sivakasi, India's fireworks hub, because of a shortage of labour, rising raw material costs, transport disruptions, new safety compliance requirements, weaker export orders, delayed monsoon drying schedules, power cuts at drying yards, and a long list of additional local complications that factory owners described in detail to reporters visiting the cluster this week ahead of the season.
payoff: Same Diwali sparkle — about a fifth more money.
